reason: The filing is a semi-annual financial report (Relazione Finanziaria Semestrale Consolidata) for Juventus Football Club S.p.A. for the period ending December 31, 2025. The document contains standard financial information including income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, management discussion, and operational updates related to the football club's activities (player transfers, sponsorships, stadium revenues, media rights, etc.). No Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures are disclosed by the company in this filing. The document focuses on historical financial results and operational metrics specific to Juventus rather than market sizing for the broader football/sports entertainment industry.
